lines: CÉLINE DION - PARIS 2026-2027 – Ticketmaster FR Help
Where and when does this event take place?
Exclusive dates in September and October 2026 at Plenitude Arena for a show that is already shaping up to be historic.
Céline Dion concert starts at 8:00 PM
What are the prices and ticket types for this event?
Prices are determined by the Event Organizer and depend on artist, event and venue. Prices will be published on the event page once the sale has started.
What methods of payment can I use?
For this event you will be able to pay by bank card.
What method of delivery can I select for this event?
The Fan Wallet app is available for free on iPhone and Android—starting with iOS 16 and Android 10.
Tickets are now available for download in the Fan Wallet app.
The access barcodes for the 2026 concerts will be revealed 7 days before your concert date.
If you have not yet downloaded your tickets to the Fan Wallet app, follow the steps:
1- Install the application on your smartphone from the App Store (iPhone) or Google Play (Android).
2- From your smartphone, connect to the site where you bought the tickets
3- Log in to your account and select the order you wish to download
4- Click on the link to download your tickets.

Can I cancel my tickets after I’ve purchased it?
No, you can’t. Once tickets have been purchased they’re not refundable.
I can no longer attend the event. Can I resell my tickets?
The resale service is enabled for tickets purchased through our network. Log in to your customer account to manage the tickets you wish to offer to other fans.
The service will close at 11:00 pm CEST on the day before each concert.
Tickets that have not been resold by the time the service closes remain valid and grant access to the show.
Booking for PMR and PSH tickets can only be made by phone at 01 46 91 57 57, Monday through Friday from 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. and Saturday from 9:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (subject to availability).

What are the age restrictions for the event?
No age restriction applies but minors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Regardless of age (even infants) must have a ticket.
I am under 16 years old. Can I attend the event?
Yes, only if you are accompanied by an adult.
Can I bring my baby to the concert?
Everyone, regardless of age (even infants), must have a ticket.
